content.question: What is clustering?
options: An unsupervised learning methodology that groups similar data points based on their features to detect natural groupings in the data.
A supervised learning method that assigns predefined class labels to data points.
A technique that reduces the number of features while preserving as much information as possible.
A reinforcement learning approach where an agent learns from rewards and penalties.
content.answer: An unsupervised learning methodology that groups similar data points based on their features to detect natural groupings in the data.
